properties.text: KZG commitment validation must reject the point at infinity (identity element of the elliptic curve group) as an invalid commitment. A commitment equal to the identity point does not correspond to any valid polynomial and must not pass verification.
properties.assertion: forall commitment c in verify_cell_kzg_proof or verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch: c != G1_IDENTITY (point at infinity) => reject

properties.text: KZG proof verification must correctly handle edge cases where the commitment, proof, or evaluation point is the identity element (point at infinity) of the BLS12-381 G1 group. Pairing checks must not silently pass for degenerate inputs.
properties.assertion: forall proof_verify(commitment, proof, z, y): if commitment == G1_IDENTITY || proof == G1_IDENTITY => pairing check must still be evaluated correctly, not short-circuited to accept

properties.text: Batch KZG proof verification must validate that no input commitment is the point at infinity before aggregating commitments into the random linear combination. The point at infinity in a batch cancels its contribution to the pairing equation, allowing forged proofs for that commitment to pass undetected.
properties.assertion: forall batch in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch: forall i: commitments[i] != G1_IDENTITY, OR the aggregation must weight identity-point commitments such that verification still detects invalid proofs

metadata.note: Manual properties for Sherlock issue #48 (rust-eth-kzg point of infinity). KZG commitment/proof verification must correctly handle the identity element of BLS12-381 G1 group.
